expert.title: Expert mode
expert.modeInfo: Unlocks an Expert page where you can override the power (wattage) values used for the energy estimate.
expert.powerInfo: Wattage used to estimate energy use. Defaults match your spa model; adjust to your actual hardware.
expert.heatLossInfo: Heat loss (W per Kelvin) is one factor in the "time to reach target" estimate. Set it manually here.
expert.calInfo: Measures how fast the water cools to derive the heat loss. Starting it turns the heater, AirJet and HydroJet off and the filter pump on, then times the interval between two consecutive sensor steps (the display temporarily switches to °F for finer resolution). Works best when the water is much warmer than the surroundings.
expert.calConfirm: This will turn the heater, AirJet and HydroJet off, switch the filter pump on and temporarily set the display to °F, then time the cool-down between two sensor steps. This can take a few hours. Start the calibration?
expert.calHow: How it works: the spa reports the water temperature only in whole degrees, so the calibration waits until the reading steps down once (at that exact moment the true temperature crosses a degree boundary), then times how long it takes to step down once more. From that interval, the water volume and the pump's heat input it derives the heat loss in W per Kelvin. Each of the two steps typically takes 30 minutes to a few hours depending on insulation and weather - expect roughly 1-6 hours in total. The run ends automatically, saves the result and restores the previous pump/heater/display state; keep the cover on and don't use the spa during the measurement.
expert.calPreparing: Preparing: pump on, heater/jets off - letting the water circulate…
expert.calWaitTick: The sensor only reports whole degrees - waiting for the reading to step down once…
expert.calRestoring: The spa changed its pump/heater state - restoring the measuring state…
expert.calDiscarded: {n} measuring interval(s) discarded and restarted (e.g. mixing or sloshing) - this is normal, the measurement keeps running.
expert.calErr.tempdiff: The water must be at least 8 K warmer than the surroundings for an accurate measurement.
expert.calAbort.prep: Calibration stopped because the spa did not reach the required pump/heater state.
expert.calAbort.interrupted: Calibration stopped because the pump/heater state changed and could not be restored within 5 minutes.
expert.calAbort.timeout: Calibration stopped because the water did not cool enough within 36 hours.
expert.calAbort.unstable: Calibration stopped because the measured temperature drop was not plausible.
